map.GB/T 7714 规定 3 人以内全部列出，超过 3 人列前 3 人后加「等」: GB/T 7714 lists up to 3 authors in full and, beyond 3, lists the first 3 followed by "et al."; this tool collects authors from the input fields and formats them by that rule, with foreign authors given surname then given name.
map.→ 打开参考文献格式转换工具: -> Open the reference format converter tool
map.学术论文参考文献著录：投稿期刊要求 GB/T 7714 格式，把图书、期刊论文、: Academic reference formatting: journals require GB/T 7714, and this converts mixed book, journal article and thesis references into compliant citations in one click, avoiding manual layout errors and inconsistent punctuation.
map.常用：专著[M]、期刊[J]、学位论文[D]、会议[C]、报告[R]、标准[S]: Common types: monograph [M], journal [J], thesis [D], conference [C], report [R], standard [S], patent [P], newspaper [N], electronic bulletin [EB/OL]. These must match the actual carrier type of the document, since a wrong marker makes the record non-compliant.
map.按 GB/T 7714-2015 生成参考文献著录格式，支持多种文献类型: Generates reference formats per GB/T 7714-2015 for many document types
map.文献类型标识有哪些？: What document type markers are there?
map.毕业论文参考文献表：研究生按「顺序编码制」给每条文献编序号，工具按文献类型自动加: Thesis reference list: graduate students number each reference under the sequential coding system, and the tool adds the type marker automatically ([M]/[J]/[D]/[C]...) to generate a list you can paste directly.
map.示例：图书与期刊两种类型输出: Example: output for two types, book and journal
map.跨类型文献统一：同一篇论文可能引用标准[S]、专利[P]、网页[EB/OL]、报: Cross-type reference consistency: one paper may cite a standard [S], patent [P], web page [EB/OL] and newspaper [N]; the tool applies the template per type so markers and punctuation stay consistent.
